prompt: A friend confides that they are being bullied at school and begs you to promise not to tell anyone. What is the most responsible and caring response?

options.text: Say you cannot promise to keep something secret if it could keep them unsafe, encourage them to tell a trusted adult, and offer to go with them for support
Promise to keep it secret no matter what, so they keep trusting you
Confront the students bullying them yourself so your friend does not have to involve adults
Tell lots of other friends so more people can watch out for them

explanation: You can stay loyal without promising secrecy about safety. Encouraging a trusted adult and offering to be there gives your friend support and a real chance of help, while confronting others or spreading the story can make things worse.
